006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.TypeConstants;
012
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014import inet.ipaddr.IPAddress;
015
016/**
017 * An atomic Metapath item representing an IP address data value.
018 */
019// FIXME: Should this be a subtype of IStringItem?
020public interface IIPAddressItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
021  /**
022   * Get the type information for this item.
023   *
024   * @return the type information
025   */
026  @NonNull
027  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IIPAddressItem> type() {
028    return TypeConstants.IP_ADDRESS_TYPE;
029  }
030
031  @Override
032  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends IIPAddressItem> getType() {
033    return type();
034  }
035
036  /**
037   * Get the "wrapped" IP address value.
038   *
039   * @return the underlying IP address value
040   */
041  @NonNull
042  IPAddress asIpAddress();
043
044  /**
045   * Compares this value with the argument.
046   *
047   * @param item
048   *          the item to compare with this value
049   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
050   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
051   */
052  default int compareTo(IIPAddressItem item) {
053    return asIpAddress().compareTo(item.asIpAddress());
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
058   *
059   * @param item
060   *          the item to cast
061   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
062   *         cast to this type
063   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
064   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
065   */
066  @NonNull
067  static IIPAddressItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
068    IIPAddressItem retval;
069    if (item instanceof IIPAddressItem) {
070      retval = (IIPAddressItem) item;
071    } else {
072      String value;
073      try {
074        value = item.asString();
075      } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
076        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
077        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
078      }
079
080      try {
081        // try a v6 address
082        retval = IIPv6AddressItem.valueOf(value);
083      } catch (InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
084        // try a v4 address
085        try {
086          retval = IIPv4AddressItem.valueOf(value);
087        } catch (InvalidTypeMetapathException ex2) {
088          InvalidValueForCastFunctionException newEx = new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
089              String.format("The value '%s' of type '%s' is not an internet protocol address.",
090                  value,
091                  item.getJavaTypeAdapter().getPreferredName()),
092              ex2);
093          newEx.addSuppressed(ex);
094          throw newEx;
095        }
096      }
097    }
098    return retval;
099  }
100}
